title: Merge 2 specialised systems: q02, q21
summary: I left the code as it was. The q02 and q21 patches had both applied cleanly to the working tree, so nothing needed combining. The tree builds (BUILD OK). On the quick bench (2 bindings per template, 4 hot runs each), against the current best: q02 went from 82.4 to 40.3 ms (-51.1%), q21 from 832.5 to 697.7 ms (-16.2%), and the geomean is -36.0%. Neither change slowed the other template, so I didn't guard or drop either one.
notes: The two patches touched different logic, so there was nothing to reconcile. The bench I ran was the quick check only; I didn't run the longer interleaved timing.
